matters:
The Dow added 529.85 points on Tuesday, helped by a 5%+ jump in 3M after it raised full-year profit guidance, per Kiplinger (20 Oct). The Nasdaq ended flat as chip and AI stocks, weak early, recovered part of their losses.

After the close, Netflix fell 5.8% to $64.74 in after-hours trading after guiding Q4 EPS to $0.67, below the street, per Mitrade (21 Oct). Sources differ on exact timing and figures, so treat the level as approximate.

scorecard.text: The prior regime call, tentative stabilisation, held on Tuesday: the S&P 500 rose a further 0.28% to 7,712.57, per CNBC/Kiplinger coverage.
